title: Model registry ModelVersion proto round-trip: deployment job state must be assigned into the proto via CopyFrom, and absent state must stay None
answers: Why does get_model_version return an empty deployment job state (job_id blank, job_state UNSPECIFIED) when the server has a real one?
Why is deployment_job_state missing after search_model_versions or a REST round trip of a ModelVersion?
Where is ModelVersion serialized to and hydrated from the model registry proto?
Why does a ModelVersion without a deployment job come back from from_proto as a non-None object?
body:
Path: mlflow/entities/model_registry/model_version.py:ModelVersion.to_proto and ModelVersion.from_proto convert a model version (the object returned by get_model_version, search_model_versions, and the REST store) to and from model_registry_pb2.ModelVersion, including its deployment_job_state field.
Rule: In ModelVersion.to_proto, write the nested state with model_version.deployment_job_state.CopyFrom(self.deployment_job_state.to_proto()), never as a discarded call. In ModelVersion.from_proto, build deployment_job_state only when proto.HasField("deployment_job_state"), otherwise pass None. ModelVersionDeploymentJobState.from_proto (mlflow/entities/model_registry/model_version_deployment_job_state.py) reads fields by attribute and works for either proto message class.
Symptom: Clients that hydrate a ModelVersion from the proto saw a plausible but empty deployment job state (job_id='', job_state='DEPLOYMENT_JOB_CONNECTION_STATE_UNSPECIFIED', run_state='DEPLOYMENT_JOB_RUN_STATE_UNSPECIFIED') with no error raised. A ModelVersion with no deployment job also round-tripped to a truthy empty object instead of None.
Constraints: Applies to the mlflow.entities ModelVersion path only. RegisteredModel.to_proto already assigns its state correctly and is the reference pattern. The TODO for params, metrics and model ID in to_proto is unrelated.
applies: ModelVersion <-> model_registry_pb2 proto conversion in mlflow/entities/model_registry; any new nested entity field added to ModelVersion.to_proto should follow the same assign-and-HasField pattern.
says: Fetching a model version returns an empty deployment job state instead of real data.
Searching model versions shows blank deployment job identifiers and unspecified states.
A model version with no deployment job should display nothing rather than empty details.
Model registry lookups lose deployment job progress when retrieving model version records.
Deployment job details become blank whenever model versions round trip through the service.
search: When converting ModelVersion to and from model_registry_pb2.ModelVersion, deployment_job_state must be assigned with CopyFrom during serialization and populated only if HasField succeeds during deserialization. Failing to assign via CopyFrom or unconditionally constructing the object causes hydrated model versions to return empty deployment job states with unspecified enum values instead of None or actual data. This rule applies to ModelVersion protobuf conversions in mlflow.entities and does not affect RegisteredModel or unrelated entity fields.
